blocks.title: ① 순위 상승폭 (New & Trending · Top Sellers)

items.name: CloverPit
items.desc: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

items.name: Phonopolis
items.desc: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

items.name: Punch The Walls
items.desc: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

items.name: Dice Hoarder
items.desc: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

items.name: How They Built the Pyramids
items.desc: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

items.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
items.sub: One or Eight · Action, RPG, Early Access
items.desc: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

blocks.title: ③ 절대 규모 · 7일 리뷰 증가 수

items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
items.desc: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

items.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
items.sub: Lavaflame2 · Idler, Free to Play, Incremental
items.desc: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

items.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
items.desc: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

blocks.title: 연속 회차 리뷰 증가 (3회차 이상 승격 후보)

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: ForgeTax
items.desc: A dark, first-person forging roguelite. Hammer swords into absurd fortunes, bend the odds with relics, and risk it all on your next strike. Spend precious blades to build powerful synergies. Meet the dragon's tribute—or face its wrath.

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: over the hill
items.sub: Funselektor Labs Inc. · Driving, Co-op, Adventure
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: Tiny Glade
items.sub: Pounce Light · Building, Relaxing, Design & Illustration
items.desc: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

items.name: Bills Must Be Paid
items.desc: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

items.name: CloverPit
items.desc: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a never-ending debt simulator!

items.name: Phonopolis
items.desc: Phonopolis is a story-driven puzzle adventure set in a hand-painted 3D world made of cardboard. Solve a wide variety of playful puzzles and help Felix end the Leader's oppressive influence in a resonant dystopian city inspired by avant-garde art.

items.name: Punch The Walls
items.desc: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

items.name: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
items.desc: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

items.name: Well Dweller
items.desc: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

items.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
items.sub: Ludorea games · Action, Adventure, Early Access
items.desc: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

items.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
items.sub: House of Tactics LLC · Adventure, RPG, Strategy
items.desc: Deckbuilding roguelike with new twists! Over 30 heroes whose abilities warp the rules, hundreds of summons, spells and artifacts to discover. And you can even DESIGN YOUR OWN cards at the Forge!

items.name: Point Nemo
items.desc: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs something from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.

items.name: Survivors Under Siege
items.desc: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

items.name: Block King Demands Red Squares
items.desc: Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy. Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.
